partial.contact.title: Enquire about made-to-measure furniture
partial.contact.description: Tell us briefly what you need. We will get back to you to discuss the details of your project.
partial.contact.preferencePlaceholder: Optional, e.g. SMS / WhatsApp / Messenger + profile link, or by phone — Wednesdays between 5 and 7 pm.
partial.about.description: I create made-to-measure furniture with a focus on functionality, durability and carefully considered design.
partial.about.lead: Wióry lecą is a brand built on a personal approach and reliable craftsmanship.
partial.about.materials: I specialise in fitted furniture made from furniture board and MDF, as well as lacquered fronts. I design solutions that combine style, durability and everyday comfort.
partial.about.approach: I approach every project individually. From the first conversation to installation, you deal directly with me and stay in full control of your project.
partial.about.quality: I focus on thoughtful solutions, carefully finished details and quality that looks good in photographs and, above all, performs well in everyday use.
partial.about.goal: My aim is to create furniture that fits naturally into your interior: functional, durable and suited to your lifestyle.
partial.about.invitation: If you value a straightforward approach, good communication and solid workmanship, you are in the right place.
partial.about.history: I have been in business since 2018. I make made-to-measure furniture across Lower Silesia and the Lubusz region, including Wrocław, Bolesławiec and Żagań.
partial.coop.title: How does the process work, step by step?
partial.coop.description: Creating your made-to-measure furniture is a simple, transparent process. We guide you from the first conversation to installation, taking care of every detail.
partial.coop.contactDescription: We discuss your needs and the scope of the project. This allows us to provide an initial estimate.
partial.coop.measurementDescription: We visit your property, I take precise measurements and we discuss the details of your project.
partial.coop.designDescription: We plan the furniture layout and choose the materials, refining both functionality and appearance.
partial.coop.agreementDescription: We finalise the design and agree on the project schedule and the details of our work together.
partial.coop.productionDescription: We order the materials and begin making your furniture in the workshop.
partial.coop.installationDescription: We deliver and install your furniture, paying close attention to precision and finish.
partial.coop.handoverDescription: We hand over your finished furniture, ready to use, with a few helpful tips.
